findings.title: Make explicit that a pause is not a finished turn for the existing requirements
findings.scoreReason: The existing requirements say "finishes its turn" leads to a notice and a ✅, and the new one says "ends its turn" leads to 🔨 and no notice, so the archived spec reads as ambiguous. One sentence in the spec delta; worth mentioning in the final comment, not a work item of its own.

findings.title: Pin D4: a payload that is not JSON is a finish
findings.scoreReason: jq -e fails on input that is not JSON, so the turn is treated as finished as D4 says; Claude Code always sends JSON, and the test is a one-line addition.
